campaign_duration.meaning: duration of the created campaign, stated to be at least 1 hour

start_timestamp.meaning: supplied startTimestamp parameter of the campaign being created

block_timestamp_at_creation.meaning: block.timestamp at the moment of campaign creation

campaign_fully_elapsed_at_creation.meaning: the created campaign is already fully elapsed at creation, i.e. startTimestamp + duration <= block.timestamp

full_fees_paid_for_nondistributing_campa.meaning: users pay full fees and token amounts for a campaign that can never distribute rewards

assumptions: The campaign duration is measured in seconds and the 1-hour minimum equals 3600 seconds.
startTimestamp and block.timestamp are comparable integer timestamps in seconds.

unresolved.description: The intent requires startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp, but the predicate grammar has no addition over symbols in a comparison; the fully-elapsed relation is captured only via the grounded bool campaign_fully_elapsed_at_creation and the temporal_order pattern.
Report does not quantify the exact fee and token amounts charged, so the impact is encoded as a grounded Boolean outcome.

limitations: The temporal_order pattern expresses the intent's ordering requirement (start must be after block.timestamp) rather than the exact sum startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp.
The impact's 'can never distribute rewards' mechanism is not separately formalized; only the fee-payment outcome is encoded.
